relationship_type: physical manufacturer candidate / enclosure and wiring evidence
evidence_summary: A 2025 follow-up documents a used Clark Fuzz advertised October 5 1968, while the broader historical reconstruction records former Clark employee Rich Excellente as having wired fuzz boxes there and a Clark-labeled unit carrying a Manufactured and Distributed by Clark Music Industries instruction label. These combined facts support Clark as the strongest current physical-builder candidate, while not proving that every East Coast Fuzz-branded variant came from Clark.

evidence_summary: The evidence now points more strongly toward Clark as a production center for at least part of the family, but the family uses multiple enclosure generations and component variations. Treating every marketed identity as a Clark build remains premature.

A genuine new-gear store advertisement places Manny's Fuzz in Cleveland on January 18 1968, and a collector report independently places acquisition in Cleveland in 1967 or 1968. Distribution is therefore established, but the physical builder is not proven by this evidence alone.

The Clark Fuzz was documented in a Syracuse Herald-Journal classified dated October 5 1968. Broader Clark evidence includes former-employee testimony, the Clark manufacturer/distributor label, and workshop context in Clark, New Jersey.

Andre Fuzzier shares several physical-production traits with East Coast Fuzz examples and Andre reverb units, including unusual hardware and construction details. The stronger hypothesis is a common manufacturing source or workshop relationship; direct East Coast Fuzz factory attribution remains unproven.

A September 13 1968 St. Louis Post-Dispatch classified documents an Orpheum Fuzz as an existing used-market unit, establishing the model in commercial circulation by that date. Factory attribution remains unresolved.

One photographed Orpheum Fuzz reportedly has the name Gene written on an interior wood side. Because Gene Andre worked in New Jersey and has several apparently related builds, this is an intriguing lead but is not sufficient for factory attribution.
